text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Name's Air Shakur. Just so you know, I 
don't expect a damn thing from you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll hear out your suggestions, but I'm 
the one who decides. Make sure you 
understand that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you dare get in my way, our contract 
ends right then and there. Keep that 
firmly engraved in your mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
